# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Instead, report them via GitHub's private [Security Advisories](../../security/advisories/new) feature. Include a description of the issue, steps to reproduce, and potential impact. If private reporting is unavailable, contact the project maintainers using the contact information on the [project owner's GitHub profile](https://github.com/ranajahanzaib).

The maintainers will review the report and share an acknowledgment and any available next steps through the advisory.
